answer: We hash every delivery receipt at pickup and publish only the hash, so a courier cannot shop for a better grade after the fact; the panel that grades it is drawn from a rotating pool, and a receipt drawing conflicting grades goes back to a second panel. That second pass is where the delta shows: an honest courier loses two days of payout, while a farm padding its atlas with drops from an empty dune loses the same two days a thousand times, which costs more than the umber it earns.
